## **Bugs und Stabilität** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs und Stabilität.**
      5 aktuelle Review(s) erwähnen bugs und stabilität.
      Review-Fenster: 14.09.2026 - 13.10.2026
      **Warum das zählt:** Nutzer erwähnen Crashes oder Instabilität. Nur bei Volume-Spike oder nach einem Update als actionable werten; sonst oft Baseline-Rauschen.

         **Review-Beispiele:**
            1. _Kad2011_, 30.09.2026, 3/5: "I actually LOVE this app. I found it this week and I’d already had so much more focus when using it, but it drains my battery so much. I did a 40min focus session and it drained my battery by 20% and my phone is getting really hot. I thought it may have just been my phone, but my friend who recommended it is getting the same issue so we’re going to stop using sadly 💔"
            2. _Su Zazai_, 12.10.2026, 4/5: "It makes studying something I actually look forward to doing which is very strange as I practically hated studying the only thing is I experience this bug that when I get off the app I can still hear the music and I’ve deactivated the music but it still plays it only stopped when I uninstalled the app ."
            3. _0frenz_, 13.10.2026, 5/5: "I love this app. Literally it helps me lock in. My ONLY problem and this is a me problem. Is I use the app and study so much because I don’t have any friends. Like non. So my only issue is I can’t unlock the plane or finish my quests because I have to add friends in order to do it lol. But that’s a me issue, and again I LOVE THE APP. I just wish I could finish my quests lol."
